newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine holding Grupo Roberts to launch IPO.
newsitem.headline: Argentine holding Grupo Roberts to launch IPO.

text.p: Private Argentine financial services and insurance holding Grupo Roberts plans to launch an initial public offering in Buenos Aires and New York of between $100 million to $150 million this year, its executive director Jorge Heinze said Wednesday.
"Our intention is to open the group to capital in the stock market," Heinze told Reuters. "The amount will be between $100 million and $150 million."
"We are in talks with Morgan Stanley to arrange the issue," Heinze said.
He added the IPO will be launched in 1997.

Roberts SA de Inversiones, the full name of the group, has a 70.1 percent stake in Banco Roberts, 100 percent of health care company Docthos, near 100 percent of insurance firm La Buenos Aires and a 35 percent stake in pension fund Maxima AFJP.
Heinze said the holding company will list on the stock markets and not the firms which it controls.
Part of La Buenos Aires capital quotes on the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.
